messages:
olivia_cs: Quick weekly pulse for Kestrel Labs — p95/p99 latency split by route + model, streaming vs non-streaming. Posting the 7d snapshot and quick notes.

olivia_cs: TL;DR: overall usage up 12% w/ a spike on /chat. Streaming p95 improved vs non-streaming on rw-13b-v1 but p99 tails on rw-30b-q8 for /generate. Error rate stable ~0.4%. Spend +8% week-over-week. :bar_chart: :money_with_wings:

olivia_cs: Raw numbers (median p95 / p99 ms, streaming | non-streaming) for most-used routes: 
- /chat (rw-13b-v1):  p95 120ms | 210ms  (streaming)  vs  180ms | 430ms (non-streaming)
- /generate (rw-30b-q8): p95 260ms | 520ms (streaming)  vs  240ms | 480ms (non-streaming)
- /embed (open-embed-2): p95 40ms | 90ms (streaming)  vs 40ms | 95ms (non-streaming)

mike_eng: Nice. So for /generate rw-30b-q8 streaming p95 is slightly worse but p99 is worse on streaming — any tail source?

olivia_cs: @mike_eng yep looks like huge variance when token lengths > 1024, KV cache churn + occasional fallback to cpu-hosted quantized kernels. Telemetry shows those requests hit burst pool around 2-3am UTC.

mike_eng: Ah. Are these the long-context synthesis jobs from Kestrel's research team?

tanya_am: I flagged long-context pipelines in last onboarding call — they said they'd start longer batch jobs this week. Might be correlated.

simon_prod: Can we get a quick query? telemetry-bot, can you post the group-by over sequence_length buckets for rw-30b-q8 on /generate last 7d?

telemetry-bot: Query queued: `rwd.metrics.query --customer Kestrel --route /generate --model rw-30b-q8 --range 7d --group seq_len_bucket,streaming`

telemetry-bot: Results ready — top buckets: seq_len 1-512 (65% requests), 513-1024 (18%), 1025-2048 (12%), 2049+ (5%). 2049+ has p99 ~1.5s and accounts for 42% of p99 tail.

olivia_cs: Actionable: recommend schedule and docs note to suggest using streaming for long outputs AND enable prefix/KV caching for repeated contexts. Also suggest trying rw-30b-q4mix for heavy long-context batches.

tanya_am: I'll sync with Kestrel onboarding: propose a short enablement session next Tue to review batching and model suggestions.

mike_eng: Engineering action: can we add an autoscale rule to prioritize GPU burst pool for streaming requests on /generate when seq_len > 1024? aaron_ops take?

aaron_ops: I can prototype a policy: `policy: if route==\"/generate\" and seq_len>1024 and streaming==true then route->gpu-burst`. Will test on staging. ETA 48h.

simon_prod: Also flagging cost: rw-30b-q8 streaming tails are driving +$1.2k extra on this account last 7d. If they switch to q4mix savings could be ~30% for those tails.

olivia_cs: Error rate note: 0.4% overall, but api_timeouts for long runs rose to 1.2% in 2049+ bucket. We should advise retries with exponential backoff and streaming chunking.

mike_eng: For quick diagnostics I'll drop this snippet — helps reproduce high-latency sample:```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "model": "rw-30b-q8",
  "tokens": 2800,
  "streaming": true
}
```

tanya_am: Great — I'll include that repro in the enablement deck.

olivia_cs: Next steps:
- tanya_am schedule enablement + share doc (due Wed)
- aaron_ops prototype autoscale policy (48h)
- mike_eng validate fallback logs for kernel selection (ETA 2d)
- simon_prod send cost-savings estimate vs q4mix (EOD tomorrow)

simon_prod: noted. Will send a short calc and sample request-level cost slice.

aaron_ops: Staging test started — will post results in this thread when done.

telemetry-bot: Alert: Kestrel total spend (7d) = $12,340 (+8% WoW). Top cost drivers: rw-30b-q8 /generate (49% of spend).

olivia_cs: Thanks all. I'll follow up after enablement. If anyone wants the per-route CSV I can export and share. :thumbsup:
